create_PredictionDumper: create a PredictionDumper to collect and dump COCO-format predictions from a model in distributed training
build_coco_predictions: build COCO-format detection predictions from model outputs with bounding boxes and scores
build_coco_segmentation: build COCO-format segmentation predictions with RLE-encoded masks from model outputs
run_gather_and_merge: run gather_and_merge_predictions to collect and merge top detections per image across distributed processes
summarize_synchronize: summarize synchronized predictions across all processes and compute evaluation metrics
